title: USA Computing Olympiad (USACO)
description: Algorithmic programming contests with divisions from bronze to platinum; a selection route to the IOI and European Girls Olympiad in Informatics.
eligibility: Online contests open worldwide; only pre-college students in the USA can become training-camp finalists and contend for USA teams.
cost: There is never any fee for participation.

eligibility: Full-time high-school students with permanent US residency during the academic year; citizenship not required; individuals or pairs.
location: United States; mentoring and possible MIT campus visit

title: ICBS High School Poster Session
description: Selective high-school original-research poster session at the International Congress of Basic Sciences; up to 100 works selected for presentation.
eligibility: School-nominated high-school students; up to five posters per school; original research in mathematics, physics, computer science or economic/financial modeling. Invitation addresses international schools; attached details also say nationwide, so overseas eligibility should be confirmed.
cost: Selected first authors and leading teacher receive complimentary conference passes, lunch and dinner; school covers transportation and lodging.

location: Texas A&M University Student Recreation Center, College Station, Texas
lifecycleEvidence: 2027 Texas Science and Engineering Fair | April 2–3, 2027
cost: $50 per student; school/district or parent/guardian may pay.

title: Fort Worth Regional Science and Engineering Fair (FWRSEF)
description: Regional science fair serving Tarrant County and neighboring counties, with advancement to TXSEF. Official past results include Martin High School and Martin STEM School participants.
